zh: 轮次进行中那一行等待时只说品牌自己的那一个词：Claude 品牌下是皮肤自己的「正在思考」，DeepSeek 品牌下是宿主自己的「深度求索中」；模型思考与读不出状态两种情形共用这一个词，读不出状态不再换一次说法。
en: While a turn runs, the line stands on one word per brand: the skin's own "Thinking…" under the Claude brand and the host's own "Deep diving" under the DeepSeek brand, and a model thinking and a turn whose state cannot be read use that one word, so a wait no longer changes wording.
